raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week resistance-focused program for insulin sensitivity and body comp"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity and body composition through progressive resistance training with med-high frequency and auto-regulatory guidance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Hypertrophy/Technique Foundation":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full-body stability and movement quality":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          overhead_arm_pull 60 seconds
          thoracic_openers 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower/upper push-pull mix":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_hinge_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression and technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7
          rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Stability and hinge work":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..7 rpe 7
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          core activation 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Volume cap and accessory mix":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7
          bicep_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          mobility flow 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength with progressive overload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Pull emphasis and posterior chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7
          external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Push/push and core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7
          plank 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          guinea_stretch sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Volume maintenance with auto-reg":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7
          deadlift 3x5..7 rpe 7
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          mobility flow 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper back and grip":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3xdoes_not_exceed 0 rpe 0
          bent_over_row 4x6..10 rpe 7
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          scapular_retraction 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower body fundamentals":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7
          glute_bridge 4x10..15 rpe 7
          calf_raise 4x15..20 rpe 7
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10..15 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength peak and density":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Posterior chain and core":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push strength and accessory density":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Tempos and control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_spine_mobility 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Accessory density":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          concentration_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full-body finishers":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 7
          press_ups 3x8..12 rpe 7
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7
          plank 3x45 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_release 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names — no variants, no plurals):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, inverted_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, hangboard, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing, scapular_retraction, external_rotation, internal_rotation, prone_T, prone_Y, prone_W, pelvic_tilt, diaphragmatic_breathing

CARDIO MODALITIES (use ONLY these names for warmups, cooldowns, and cardio sessions):
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes:
- This program prioritizes resistance training with adequate protein-friendly structure, minimum crash cardio, and autoregulated progression to support insulin sensitivity and body composition for a client with PCOS.
- Week-by-week loading and exercise selection follows a progressive pattern across phases, emphasizing compound lifts early in sessions and targeted accessory work to support hormonal balance and fatigue management.
